lines.zh: 我在岩壁缝隙间摆尾，一寸一寸往前。
lines.en: I flick my tail through the rock crevice, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁游，避开上方落下的石屑。
lines.en: I hug the cave wall, dodging grit falling from above.

lines.zh: 我们排成一小队，绕水池转第三圈。
lines.en: We form a small line and circle the pool a third time.

lines.zh: 二点六厘米的身子，划出很长的水痕。
lines.en: Two centimeters of body leave a very long wake.

lines.zh: 前方的同伴一摆尾，我立刻跟上。
lines.en: A companion flicks its tail; I follow at once.

lines.zh: 水底的蓝光晃了一下，我游进那片光。
lines.en: Blue light sways on the floor; I swim into it.

lines.zh: 我绕着石柱打转，从不肯直着走。
lines.en: I circle the stone pillar, never swimming straight.

lines.zh: 二十到三十格的地下，我只认识这片水。
lines.en: Twenty blocks down, this pool is the only world I know.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，背鳍划开一圈细纹。
lines.en: I skim the surface, my dorsal fin drawing thin rings.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水，我侧身让开水珠。
lines.en: Water drips from the ceiling; I tilt aside to let it pass.

lines.zh: 我游得比看起来快，一闪就到石后。
lines.en: I swim faster than I look, gone behind the stone.

lines.zh: 同伴散开又聚拢，我夹在中间。
lines.en: The school scatters and gathers; I stay in the middle.

lines.zh: 我用尾鳍拨开沙粒，找出藏在下面的路。
lines.en: My tail sweeps sand aside, uncovering the way beneath.

lines.zh: 水很暖，暖得我从不浮上冷的一层。
lines.en: The water is warm; I never rise to the cold layer.

lines.zh: 我顺着石壁上的凹槽游下去
lines.en: I follow a groove in the rock downward.

lines.zh: 同伴的影子在沙上晃，我跟着
lines.en: My kin's shadow sways on the sand; I follow.

lines.zh: 一滴水从洞顶落下，我绕开它
lines.en: A drop falls from the ceiling and I swerve.

lines.zh: 这片水只有这么大，我游了千遍
lines.en: This pool is all I have; I have swum it a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我停在水中央，鳃只开了一半。
lines.en: I stop midwater, gills only half open.

lines.zh: 我盯着一粒浮尘，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at a speck of drifting dust for a long while.

lines.zh: 五彩的鳞在水下暗着，像一块旧玻璃。
lines.en: My rainbow scales dim underwater, like old glass.

lines.zh: 同伴游过来碰我一下，又走了。
lines.en: A companion bumps me once, then drifts away.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里静止，连水纹都不惊。
lines.en: I rest in the crevice without stirring a ripple.

lines.zh: 一尾小鱼影子掠过，我没有追。
lines.en: A small fish shadow passes; I do not chase it.

lines.zh: 我听着洞顶的水声，一下，又一下。
lines.en: I listen to the ceiling drip, once, and again.

lines.zh: 传说二字压在我身上，我只想躲着。
lines.en: Legend weighs on me; I only want to hide.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，装成一片落叶。
lines.en: I turn sideways and pass for a fallen leaf.

lines.zh: 水里没有风，我却轻轻晃着。
lines.en: There is no wind in the water, yet I sway.

lines.zh: 我数着游过面前的同伴，一共五条。
lines.en: I count the companions passing me: five in all.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞底，等一小块石灰沉下来。
lines.en: I press to the floor, waiting for a flake of lime.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水底比身体大十倍。
lines.en: My shadow on the floor is ten times my size.

lines.zh: 我闭一下眼，水还是那么静。
lines.en: I close my eyes a moment; the water stays perfectly still.

lines.zh: 你这么大一团，水都为你让路了。
lines.en: You are such a mass; even the water gives way.

lines.zh: 我从石后探头，只露出半只眼。
lines.en: I peek from behind the stone, showing half an eye.

lines.zh: 你在洞口站了很久，我在下面看你。
lines.en: You stand at the cave mouth; I watch from below.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住整片水面，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the whole pool. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我游到离你最近的那块石头，停了。
lines.en: I swim to the nearest stone to you, and stop.

lines.zh: 你手里那个亮东西，是钩子吗？
lines.en: That bright thing in your hand — is it a hook?

lines.zh: 我们全体一起转头，看的都是你。
lines.en: All of us turn at once, and all look at you.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，水面照出你的脸。
lines.en: When you bend down, the water shows your face.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，怕你也没用。
lines.en: I have a single point of health; fear would not help.

lines.zh: 你踩到岸边的碎石，我往深处退了退。
lines.en: You step on loose gravel; I retreat a little deeper.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，这一下够呛。
lines.en: One point of health; that blow nearly ends me.

lines.zh: 鳞片翻起来，露出底下的白。
lines.en: Scales peel back, showing the white beneath.

lines.zh: 我疼得往石缝里钻，钻不进去。
lines.en: I thrash toward the crevice and cannot fit.

lines.zh: 水被染红了一点，很快又淡了。
lines.en: The water reddens a little, then fades.

lines.zh: 我的尾摆得乱七八糟，游不成直线。
lines.en: My tail beats wildly; I cannot swim straight.

lines.zh: 同伴们一下全散了，只剩我。
lines.en: The school scatters at once, leaving me alone.

lines.zh: 这点疼，比被钩住还轻。
lines.en: This hurts less than being hooked did.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，又硬撑着浮起来。
lines.en: I sink, then force myself back up.

lines.zh: 我的身体太小，伤口占了一半。
lines.en: My body is so small the wound covers half of it.

lines.zh: 再碰一次，我就只剩鳞了。
lines.en: One more touch and only scales would remain.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面晃，是饵的味道。
lines.en: Something sways at the surface — the smell of bait.

lines.zh: 我绕着那点香味转，不敢咬。
lines.en: I circle that trace of scent, afraid to bite.

lines.zh: 同伴先冲上去了，我跟着凑近。
lines.en: A companion darts up first; I drift closer too.

lines.zh: 那钩子太亮了，亮得像食物。
lines.en: The hook is too bright; bright like food.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，反复了三次。
lines.en: My jaws open and shut three times before I decide.

lines.zh: 香味钻进鳃里，我的尾自己摆了。
lines.en: The scent reaches my gills; my tail moves on its own.

lines.zh: 上钩的话，我会游到二点一速。
lines.en: If hooked, I could swim at twice my pace.

lines.zh: 我离饵只剩半寸，还在犹豫。
lines.en: Half an inch from the bait, still hesitating.

lines.zh: 水里飘来碎屑，比钩子安全多了。
lines.en: Scraps drift by — far safer than any hook.

lines.zh: 我闻到熟悉的味道，是同类的鳞。
lines.en: I catch a familiar smell: scales of my own kind.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我整条鱼被推开半格。
lines.en: You bump me; my whole body slides half a block.

lines.zh: 我被水流卷了个圈，晕了一下。
lines.en: The current spins me a full turn; I reel.

lines.zh: 你那么大的碰撞箱，我根本躲不开。
lines.en: Your hitbox is huge; I cannot dodge it at all.

lines.zh: 我撞上石壁，鳞片掉了一小片。
lines.en: I strike the cave wall and lose a fleck of scale.

lines.zh: 同伴被我撞散，回头看了我一眼。
lines.en: I scatter my companions, who glance back at me.

lines.zh: 水下这么挤，你还要往里挤。
lines.en: It is crowded down here, and you push in further.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过，鳞蹭到你的靴子。
lines.en: I slip past you, my scales brushing your boot.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推到了水面，我沉回去。
lines.en: The shove lifts me to the surface; I sink back.

lines.zh: 我的身体只有零点二五格宽，还是被碰到了。
lines.en: I am a quarter block wide, and still you touch me.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我缩进石头的凹处。
lines.en: Water splashes; I shrink into a hollow of stone.

lines.zh: 我绕着同伴转圈，尾鳍轻轻扫它。
lines.en: I circle my companion, tail fin brushing lightly.

lines.zh: 水底那圈细沙，是我挑好的地方。
lines.en: That ring of fine sand below is the spot I chose.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬着，谁都不先动。
lines.en: We hang side by side, neither moving first.

lines.zh: 它身上的蓝比我亮，我跟在后面。
lines.en: Its blue outshines mine; I follow behind.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰它的侧腹，它没躲开。
lines.en: I nudge its flank with my snout; it does not flinch.

lines.zh: 石缝里那群小鱼，是我们的将来。
lines.en: The fry in that crevice are what we will leave.

lines.zh: 我绕它第三圈时，水纹乱了一瞬。
lines.en: On my third circle, the ripples blur for a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 它的鳞映着我的鳞，两片光叠在一起。
lines.en: Its scales mirror mine; two glimmers overlap.

lines.zh: 我们游得很慢，慢到像同一尾鱼。
lines.en: We swim so slowly we seem one fish.

lines.zh: 这池水太窄，只够养一小群孩子。
lines.en: This pool is narrow, barely room for a small brood.

lines.zh: 水底那片鳞，我叼起来又吐掉。
lines.en: I pick up a scale from the floor, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 你把桶放下来，我知道那是什么。
lines.en: You lower the bucket; I know what it means.

lines.zh: 桶里的水晃，我贴着桶壁转圈。
lines.en: Water sways in the bucket; I circle its wall.

lines.zh: 我叼住一小块碎屑，游回石缝。
lines.en: I carry a crumb back to my crevice.

lines.zh: 落进水里的东西，我都想试一口。
lines.en: Whatever falls into the water, I want a taste.

lines.zh: 桶盖一合，这片深渊就换成了木壁。
lines.en: The lid shuts; the abyss becomes wooden walls.

lines.zh: 我捡起一粒沙，又放了下去。
lines.en: I pick up a grain of sand and put it back down.

lines.zh: 被装走的时候，我还在找出口。
lines.en: As I am carried off, I am still looking for a way out.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西也值得你伸手来拿。
lines.en: Even something this small is worth reaching for.

lines.zh: 我在桶里转了很久，才明白水没变。
lines.en: I circle the bucket a while before realizing the water hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 我看见水里的一点白，视线锁住了。
lines.en: A fleck of white in the water; my gaze locks on.

lines.zh: 那条抢食的同伴，我记住它了。
lines.en: That companion stealing food — I have noted it.

lines.zh: 水纹里有个影子在动，我盯上它。
lines.en: A shadow moves in the ripples; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我把钩子当成虫子，游了过去。
lines.en: I take the hook for an insect and swim toward it.

lines.zh: 目标很小，小到只有一粒沙那么点。
lines.en: The target is tiny, no bigger than a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我锁定你桶边漏下的那点饵。
lines.en: I lock onto the bait leaking by your bucket.

lines.zh: 全群都朝一个方向看，我也转过去。
lines.en: The whole school looks one way; I turn too.

lines.zh: 那片浮鳞不是食物，我盯得更紧。
lines.en: That floating scale is no food; I watch it harder.

lines.zh: 我看准了水面那只落脚的虫子。
lines.en: I fix on the insect that landed on the surface.

lines.zh: 这么小的目标，我也要试探一下。
lines.en: Even a target this small deserves a quick test.

lines.zh: 我数着它的摆尾，等一个空隙。
lines.en: I count its tailbeats, waiting for one gap.

lines.zh: 我不冲，鱼要先看清再动。
lines.en: I do not charge; a fish looks before it moves.

lines.zh: 我的尾停住，整个身子对准了它。
lines.en: My tail stills; my whole body points at it.

lines.zh: 它一沉，我就往下压半格。
lines.en: When it sinks, I sink half a block with it.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃眼，我还是没眨眼。
lines.en: The surface glare stings, yet I do not blink.

lines.zh: 同伴都退开了，圈里只剩我们两个。
lines.en: The others back away; only we two remain inside.

lines.zh: 我贴着石底靠近，尽量不带水声。
lines.en: I creep along the floor, keeping the water quiet.

lines.zh: 那点东西不动了，我也不敢动。
lines.en: The thing stops moving; I dare not move either.

lines.zh: 它要是犯错，我的牙就在那儿。
lines.en: If it slips, my teeth will be right there.

lines.zh: 一点血的身子，也只敢试探一次。
lines.en: With one point of health, I get only one try.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，连皮都没咬破。
lines.en: I bite once and fail to break the skin.

lines.zh: 尖锐的小牙只够留下一点印子。
lines.en: My tiny teeth leave only the faintest mark.

lines.zh: 我撞向它的鳃盖，它甩头躲开。
lines.en: I ram its gill cover; it jerks away.

lines.zh: 这一口很小，但你感觉到了。
lines.en: The bite is small, but you felt it.

lines.zh: 我咬住线头，用力往后拽。
lines.en: I clamp onto the line and haul backward.

lines.zh: 我的攻击轻得像水草扫过脚踝。
lines.en: My strike is as light as weed across an ankle.

lines.zh: 它比我大三倍，我还是冲了上去。
lines.en: Three times my size, and still I charge.

lines.zh: 咬完我就退，躲在石头后面。
lines.en: I bite, retreat, and hide behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我只有这么点力气，全用在这一下。
lines.en: This is all the force I have, spent in one snap.

lines.zh: 水花很小，可这已经是我的全力。
lines.en: The splash is small, but it is all my strength.

lines.zh: 我从钓线那头被拉上来，满身是水。
lines.en: I am hauled up the fishing line, dripping wet.

lines.zh: 这池深渊水里，忽然有了我。
lines.en: Into this abyss pool, suddenly, I exist.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，四周只有石壁和水。
lines.en: I open my eyes to stone walls and water only.

lines.zh: 传说里的鱼，从钩子上掉了下来。
lines.en: A fish of legend slips off the hook.

lines.zh: 我不是天生的，我是被钓出来的。
lines.en: I was not born here; I was fished out.

lines.zh: 潮湿的石头味，是我闻到的第一样。
lines.en: Wet stone is the first thing I ever smelled.

lines.zh: 水下很暗，我花了很久才看清。
lines.en: The water is dark; it takes me long to see.

lines.zh: 我落进水里，同伴们立刻围过来。
lines.en: I drop into the water and companions gather at once.

lines.zh: 一点血的心跳，快得像敲石。
lines.en: A one-point heart beats like a chisel on stone.

lines.zh: 我一出现，这池水就不算空了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, this pool is no longer empty.

lines.zh: 火一过，我就成了小份熟鱼。
lines.en: One pass of flame and I am a small cooked fish.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔到石头上，弹了一下。
lines.en: I fall from the surface onto stone and bounce once.

lines.zh: 鱼也会溺水，只是我说不出口。
lines.en: Even a fish can drown; I just cannot say so.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，水把我推得翻了个身。
lines.en: A muffled blast flips me over in the water.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的背鳍，掉了两片鳞。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my dorsal fin and takes two scales.

lines.zh: 一股怪力钻进水里，我的鳞全竖了。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into the water; every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 池里没有食，我瘦得只剩骨架。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in this pool; I am down to bones.

lines.zh: 雷打进洞里，水一下亮成白色。
lines.en: Lightning strikes into the cave; the water flashes white.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走了水，我的鳃再也合不上。
lines.en: The void drains the water; my gills can never close again.
